purpose: Separate upstream/leading signals from reactive/confirmation signals without changing any production score, weight, threshold or promotion status.

roles.LEADING: Has predeclared forward transmission/usefulness evidence and does not show robust market-to-signal dominance under the fixed directional diagnostics.
roles.REACTIVE_CONFIRMATION: Market-to-signal predictive precedence is robust while signal-to-market precedence is absent or materially weaker; use primarily as conditions/confirmation context.
roles.MIXED: Forward usefulness exists but temporal direction is bidirectional, regime-dependent, control-sensitive or otherwise ambiguous.
roles.UNRESOLVED: Evidence is insufficient to classify without adding new research degrees of freedom.

fixed_layers.reason: It is contemporaneous/price confirmation by construction, not an upstream macro predictor.

money_direction_protocol.signal_availability: Money observation month t is investable only from t+1, matching the promoted transmission contract.
money_direction_protocol.monthly_directional_test: Bidirectional Granger predictive-precedence on stationary signal transform versus exact-ticker monthly adjusted log return.
money_direction_protocol.multiple_testing: Holm correction within each asset and direction across the three fixed lags.
money_direction_protocol.lead_lag_check: Compare promoted predictor association with forward 12M return versus trailing 12M return using the same available signal months.
money_direction_protocol.subsample_check: Repeat the fixed 3M directional test excluding 2020-03 through 2021-12; no additional subperiod search.
money_direction_protocol.classification_rule: Money is LEADING if its already-promoted forward transmission remains intact and no majority of fixed assets shows robust market-to-Money dominance after Holm and the fixed ex-pandemic check. If market-to-Money dominance is broad/robust, classify MIXED rather than rewriting Core.

guardrail: This taxonomy changes interpretation labels only. Any future scoring/weight change requires a separately frozen versioned decision-engine candidate.
